user.title: Set up HiSosed
user.description: HiSosed runs right here, with no internet needed. Programs, sounds and speakers are set up later in the HiSosed panel in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HiSosed can only be added once.

start.name: Turn the schedule on
start.description: The program will play by itself, but only at its scheduled times.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Silences the program right away and turns its schedule off.

run_now.name: Play now
run_now.description: The program plays right now for the given number of minutes, ignoring the schedule.

regenerate.name: Shuffle
regenerate.description: Picks new moments for the sounds for the rest of the current cycle.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: Layer name or ID. Leave empty to shuffle all of them.

apply_preset.name: Switch mode
apply_preset.description: Switches layers, sounds, frequency and volume to a saved mode.

set_layer.name: Turn a layer on or off
set_layer.description: Turns a layer on or mutes it without deleting anything.

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Whether the layer should be on.

entity_id.name: Speakers
entity_id.description: Where to play. If empty, the program's speakers are used.

snooze.name: Quiet
snooze.description: Silences every program for a while. Whatever would have played during that time is not made up later.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to stay quiet.
